p5_b0.ocr: The management of water treatment and hazardous waste disposal is critical for sustainable urban development, particularly within the context of European environmental standards. In this report, we examine the throughput of water treatment alongside hazardous waste disposal volumes to assess compliance with regulatory frameworks and identify areas for improvement. Notably, the municipal water treatment throughput serves as a benchmark for evaluating performance, with a current volume of 800,000m³.

p5_b1.ocr: As indicated in the data, the overall treatment efficiency stands at 95%, with the industrial sector achieving an 85% success rate in waste management practices. Furthermore, the total volume of waste processed in the upcoming quarters illustrates fluctuations, with the first quarter of 2025 reporting a total volume of 400m³.
